item.title: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement.

item.title: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price rise.
item.description: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price rise. Two options will be available, offering discounts on purchasing the platform with either Mario Kart World or Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. As a reminder, Switch 2 is set to increase in price within the U.S., Canada, U.K. and mainland Europe in just five days' time, meaning you have a limited window in which to still buy one for its launch price. item.title: Avengers star Mark Ruffalo has responded to the suggestion he invoked "antisemitic tropes" in his ongoing criticism of Paramount's $111 billion Warner Bros. buyout.
item.description: Avengers star Mark Ruffalo has responded to the suggestion he had invoked "antisemitic tropes" in his ongoing criticism of Paramount's $111 billion Warner Bros. buyout. Responding to the claim, made in a lengthy and unusual statement by Paramount itself, Ruffalo dubbed the accusation as "appalling and fundamentally dishonest." item.title: IGN has an exclusive excerpt of Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, including narration by Astarion actor Neil Newbon himself.
item.description: IGN has an exclusive excerpt of Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, including narration by Astarion actor Neil Newbon himself. Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, from author T. Kingfisher, is a prequel novel set before the events of Larian’s role-playing masterpiece, Baldur’s Gate 3. It follows Astarion during his time in servitude to the vampire lord Cazador Szarr. item.title: Pokémon development veteran James Turner is returning to the world of pocket monsters, after previously leaving to make The Plucky Squire.
item.description: Pokémon development veteran James Turner is returning to the world of pocket monsters, after previously leaving to make The Plucky Squire. Turner is notable as being the first Westerner to officially design Pokémon, working for years at the series' core development studio Game Freak. Four years ago, however, Turner departed the company to co-found his own studio, All Possible Futures.
